summary: Backend-only regression + plumbing verification of iter3 automation_engine.py rewrite. Added /app/backend/tests/test_bugfixes_iter3.py with 11 targeted tests covering RequestWebViewRequest import, new AutomationRunner attributes (_last_mancing_at, _session_active), new methods (_session_likely_running, _process_session_result), _do_sell signature with mancing_retry kwarg, _handle_verification webview-before-pause behavior, _cycle_vip gating on _session_likely_running, _extract_and_sell KONFIRMASI-then-Ya flow, plus regression on admin/health endpoints. Ran full suite (backend_test.py + iter2 + iter3). Result: 47/48 passed (97.9%).

The obsolete iter2 test should be removed or updated to inspect _cycle_vip/_cycle_group instead of _do_fishing_session. Not a functional regression.

critical_code_review_comments: automation_engine.py is now 880 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider splitting into modules: session_lifecycle (mancing/session gating), sell_flow (_do_sell, _inventory_favorite, gift handling), extract_flow (_extract_and_sell), verification (_handle_verification, webview logic).

_do_sell uses recursive retry via `await self._do_sell(...)` with mancing_retry+1 — safe (bounded at 2) but recursion inside long-running loop increases stack noise on gift+mancing combined paths. An iterative while-loop would be cleaner and easier to reason about for retry counters.

_handle_verification imports KeyboardButtonSimpleWebView/KeyboardButtonWebView inside the except block. Move to module-level imports for clarity and to avoid repeated import overhead on every failed click.

In _handle_verification the WebView 'success' pattern `session_done_pattern + r|berhasil|sukses|...` string-concatenates onto session_done_pattern — if session_done_pattern already ends in a group without a trailing alternation-safe boundary, this can silently mis-anchor. Prefer explicit `f'(?:{cfg.session_done_pattern})|(?:berhasil|sukses|...)'`.

RequestWebViewRequest fallback uses `platform="android"` hardcoded and passes the chat entity as both peer and bot; validate that this is correct for user-side WebView invocation (bot should be the bot entity, peer can be same, but if chat is a group the bot entity should be resolved separately).

_session_likely_running relies on vip_fish_seconds + 15s slack — group flow uses same threshold but bots may have different session lengths per user; consider making the slack configurable via a config field.
